name: The 9/10 rule fails after years outside the EU: voluntary GKV on capital income too
workings: Born 1964, first job at 20 (1984), pension from 2031: the second half of the working life is 2007.5-2031, 23.5 years, of which 9/10 (21.15) must be insured
The residence timeline covers it all: 2000-2025 under generic (country unknown: not counted), 2026-2030 in Germany with GKV (5 years). 5 < 21.15: no KVdR, so voluntary GKV
Health on the DRV pension as a voluntary member: half of 17.5% = 1,785.84; on the 5,000 of interest 16.9% = 845.00; care 4.2% on both. Under KVdR the interest would be free
Taxable share for 2031: 86.5%. Taxable income without the interest: 17,552.3040 - 3,698.0432 - 36 = 13,818.2608
The interest after the allowance (4,000) at the tariff: T(17,818.26) = 1,039.487456, against T(13,818.26) + 25% × 4,000 = 1,225.61: the tariff is lower
